review: 702.49c-1: the blocked variant tested whether ninjutsu can be activated (702.49a, already in 702.49a-1), not which defender the ninja attacks; dropped it.

skipped.reason: commander ninjutsu works from the command zone, which does not occur in the two-player games collected here; the ninjutsu behavior it shares is covered by 702.49a-1 and 702.49c-1

scenarios.title: Ninjutsu swaps an unblocked attacker for the ninja, which enters tapped and attacking

setup.notes: Ninja of the Deep Hours is a 2/2 with ninjutsu {1}{U} and draws a card when it deals combat damage to a player.

decisions: A declares their Grizzly Bears as an attacker against B.
In the declare blockers step A activates ninjutsu of Ninja of the Deep Hours, paying {1}{U} with both Islands, revealing the card and returning their attacking Grizzly Bears to hand.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.
Combat damage is dealt and A chooses to draw with the Ninja of the Deep Hours trigger.

variants.label: unblocked
variants.expected: A's Grizzly Bears is in A's hand. Ninja of the Deep Hours is on the battlefield tapped and attacking B and deals 2 combat damage to B, whose life total is 18. A draws Forest.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B declares their Grizzly Bears as a blocker of A's Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Ninjutsu cannot be activated because the attacking Grizzly Bears is blocked. Ninja of the Deep Hours stays in A's hand and the two Grizzly Bears deal 2 damage to each other and both move to their owners' graveyards.

scenarios.title: The ninjutsu creature enters attacking the same planeswalker or player as the creature it replaced

setup.notes: B controls one untapped Grizzly Bears, which does not block.

decisions: A declares Grizzly Bears as an attacker against Jace Beleren.
In the declare blockers step A activates ninjutsu of Ninja of the Deep Hours, paying {1}{U} with both Islands and returning Grizzly Bears to hand.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: attacking_planeswalker
variants.expected: Ninja of the Deep Hours enters tapped and attacking Jace Beleren and deals 2 combat damage to it, so Jace Beleren has 1 loyalty counter left. B's life total is 20 and A draws no card.

variants.label: attacking_player
variants.delta: A declares Grizzly Bears as an attacker against B instead of Jace Beleren.
variants.expected: Ninja of the Deep Hours enters tapped and attacking B and deals 2 combat damage to B, whose life total is 18. Jace Beleren keeps 3 loyalty counters and A draws Forest.

scenarios.forge_notes: 702.49c always applies when ninjutsu resolves, so the scenario has no does_not_fire variant; the blocked case belongs to 702.49a and is in 702.49a-1.
